title: Midjourney goes from generating cat images to full-body ultrasound scans
raw_excerpt: “A scan of an imaging phantom, segmented to validate how cleanly structures separate under controlled conditions.“ | Image: Midjourney Medical Midjourney CEO David Holz just showed off the company's first hardware product and plans to build a San Francisco spa, which he admitted is a bit different from the "cat pictures" produced by its AI image generator. Holz said ideally, you could do this once a year or every single day, as it "aims for image quality comparable to MRI in many ways." summary: Midjourney CEO David Holz 展示了公司首款硬件产品——基于超声波的全身扫描仪，可生成肌肉、脂肪、骨骼和器官的垂直切片图像。这标志着 Midjourney 从 AI 图像生成向医疗硬件领域的重大跨界，展示了 AI 公司探索物理世界的新方向。

title: Noam Shazeer is joining OpenAI
raw_excerpt: Noam Shazeer is leaving Google to join OpenAI. Shazeer was one of the co-authors of the 2017 paper - 'Attention Is All You Need' - that transformed the AI world. He also improved search spelling correction and created the core algorithm for AdSense.
summary: 《Attention Is All You Need》论文合著者之一 Noam Shazeer 离开谷歌加入 OpenAI。Shazeer 曾改进搜索拼写纠正并创建 AdSense 核心算法，他的加入对 OpenAI 的 Transformer 架构研究具有重要战略意义。

title: ChatGPT's market share slips below 50% for first time
raw_excerpt: ChatGPT's market share has dipped below 50% for the first time. Users are migrating to other assistants like Google's Gemini, Anthropic's Claude, and xAI's Grok. ChatGPT was the fastest app to ever reach a billion monthly users, and it still remains the most popular AI assistant worldwide. Users are increasingly willing to switch between assistants.
summary: ChatGPT 市场份额首次跌破 50%，用户正迁移至 Google Gemini、Anthropic Claude 和 xAI Grok 等竞品。尽管 ChatGPT 仍是全球最受欢迎的 AI 助手，但用户越来越愿意在不同助手间切换，市场竞争加剧。

title: Photoshop and Premiere now have AI assistants
raw_excerpt: ﻿Photoshop is one of several Adobe Creative Cloud apps to receive new conversational editing capabilities. | Image: Adobe Adobe's plan to stick AI assistants into all of its Creative Cloud suite is now fully underway, with new chatbots now rolling out to its biggest editing and design apps. As part of a public beta launching today, Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, and Frame.io now each have a bespoke AI Assistant that can be used to organize your work and automate app-specific tasks. While the AI assistants are all powered by Adobe's " conversational creative agent ," they work independently and operate "as a specialist" within each Creative Cloud app, according to Adobe's announcement. That means the Premiere AI assistant is fine-tuned for tasks like … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Adobe 在 Photoshop、Premiere、Illustrator、InDesign 和 Frame.io 中推出 AI 助手（公开测试版），每个应用都有专属的对话式 AI 代理，可自动执行特定任务并组织工作流程。这是 Adobe 将 AI 全面融入创意套件的重要一步。

title: Cursor's new model
raw_excerpt: Cursor's new model will push agentic software development far beyond autocomplete and pair programming. The massive model was trained from scratch on over 100,000 GPUs. It has more than 1.5 trillion parameters and delivers intelligence beyond coding tasks. The model will be released in the coming weeks.
summary: Cursor 即将发布从零训练的新模型，参数量超 1.5 万亿，在超过 10 万张 GPU 上训练。该模型将推动代理式软件开发超越自动补全和结对编程，预计未来几周内发布。

title: Production Infrastructure for AI Agents
raw_excerpt: Vercel introduced eve, an open-source agent framework with built-in capabilities such as durable execution, sandboxed compute, approvals, subagents, and evaluations. It aims to let developers focus on agent behavior while the framework handles production concerns.
summary: Vercel 发布开源代理框架 eve，内置持久化执行、沙箱计算、审批、子代理和评估等能力，让开发者专注于代理行为而无需处理生产基础设施问题。

title: Introducing LifeSciBench
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduced LifeSciBench, an expert-judged benchmark that evaluates AI systems on end-to-end life sciences workflows such as evidence analysis, experimental design, scientific reasoning, and research communication rather than isolated biology tasks.
summary: OpenAI 发布 LifeSciBench，一个由专家评判的基准测试，评估 AI 系统在端到端生命科学工作流（如证据分析、实验设计、科学推理和研究沟通）上的表现，而非孤立的生物学任务。

title: MolmoMotion: Language-guided 3D motion forecasting
raw_excerpt: MolmoMotion, a new motion forecasting model, predicts future 3D point trajectories in videos using language instructions and initial object positions, outperforming existing methods. The model and its dataset, MolmoMotion-1M, feature vast datasets of 3D point trajectories from 1.16M videos, with a benchmark for accuracy testing.
summary: Allen AI 发布 MolmoMotion，一种语言引导的 3D 运动预测模型，可根据语言指令和初始物体位置预测视频中未来的 3D 点轨迹。同时发布包含 116 万视频的大规模数据集 MolmoMotion-1M。
